name: droneclean-studio-desktop
description: Desktop shell of DroneClean Studio: Electron main process, preload and packaging for the editor in ../

scripts.build: npm run build:studio && npm run build:main
scripts.package: npm run build && sh scripts/build-ffmpeg.sh && electron-builder --publish never
scripts.package:test: npm run build && sh scripts/build-ffmpeg.sh && npm run package:electron:test
scripts.package:electron:test: electron-builder --publish never -c.appId=com.droneclean.studio.test "-c.productName=DroneClean Studio Test" "-c.extraMetadata.productName=DroneClean Studio Test" -c.extraMetadata.droneCleanVariant=test -c.directories.output=dist/test-app
